rationale: Contract clause 4.2 fixes EUR 1.00 = USD 1.10 for invoices dated in Q1 2026, so the USD invoicing is normalisation, not a defect (policy clause 7). The PO price of EUR 210.00/EACH converts to exactly USD 231.00, matching the invoiced unit price (clause 3), receipt GR-7711 confirms 40 of 40 EACH delivered (clauses 1 and 4), and recomputed tax at the vendor's 7.5% is exactly USD 693.00 (clause 5). No credit memos; net payable USD 9,933.00 falls in the AP_CLERK band (clause 10).
